card.name: Start of a new question or item
card.fires_on: The first word of a new question (How, What, Why) that follows a run-together answer in biology study-note text. It also fires on the first word of a new list item or sentence after a pasted definition.

modes.label: Question word after an answer
modes.description: A question word such as How, What or Why begins a new flashcard-style question right after the previous answer, with no punctuation between them.
modes.example: <<What>> is the effect of high temperatures on bacteria

modes.description: The first word or space of a new list item, heading or sentence after a finished passage.
modes.example: << There>> are three classes of legal heirs,
